NETZSCH STA 449 F3 Jupiter
NETZSCH STA 449 F3 Jupiter
Room: L.01.180
Simultaneous Thermal Analyzer – a system for TG and DSC measurements on solids, powders, or liquids.
Key Features:
Temperature range: -150 °C to 2400 °C
Heating rate: 0.001 to 50 K/min
Temperature resolution: 0.001 K
Resolution: 0.1 μg (over the entire weighing range)
Drift: < 5 μg/hour
Maximum sample load: 35000 mg (incl. crucible)
DSC enthalpy accuracy: 1% (for indium)
Design: Top-loading with motorized furnace hoist and double hoist for two furnaces
Atmospheres: inert, oxidizing, static, dynamic, vacuum; optional oxygen trap system
Vacuum: 10^{-4} mbar
Sensors: TGA, TGA-DTA, TGA-DSC, TGA-DSCcp
Sample volume (max.): TGA: up to 10 ml; DSC: 0.19 ml; DTA: 0.9 ml
